  code: '# { "Depends": "py-genlayer:1jb45aa8ynh2a9c9xn3b7qqh8sm5q93hwfp7jqmwsfhh8jpz09h6" }\n' +
    '"""AgentScore: a ruling counts once per owner, not once per wallet.\n' +
    '\n' +
    'Validators judge what each finalized Internet Court ruling means for each party. Anyone can\n' +

    "evidence needs the wallet's own signature, or is its very first money in) and signals (an\n" +
    'outsider could create them, but only by paying real money). Grades are derived by ordinary code:\n' +
    'wins against proven same-owner wallets never raise a grade, losses follow the owner to every\n' +
    'proven linked wallet, and a signal caps the escrow-free limit at $100 without costing points.\n' +
    "Only Internet Court's AI jury produces findings: a case decided by default or settlement is never\n" +
    'sent to validators, and a loss in it counts as minor.\n' +

    '\n' +

    '# Internet Court lives on Base Sepolia. Ownership links can be proven on Base Sepolia or on Base\n' +

    'RPC_URL = "https://sepolia.base.org"\n' +
